name: How does AKN Design Group provide an accurate estimate for complex home remodels?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group provide an accurate estimate for complex home remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group provides accurate estimates for complex home remodels through our integrated design-build process, which unifies design planning and construction. After an initial consultation, we often move into a more detailed design phase where CAD-supported layouts and material selections are refined. This allows us to quantify all aspects of the project, from structural changes and finishes to permit coordination and labor, leading to a precise project cost. This comprehensive approach, leveraging our over two decades of experience, ensures that the estimate reflects the true scope and high-quality craftsmanship required for your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: We provide accurate estimates by integrating design and construction under one process, developing detailed CAD layouts and material selections to quantify all project aspects, ensuring a precise project cost.
